C.S.6, Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGIST... 6687 Date 10 July 1935）

Subject (in full) World Council of Youth Pacific Area Council.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S. Sansom.

I forward herewith a summarized account of certain arrangements of the World Council of Youth Pacific Area Council to hold a students' conference in Manila, after visiting Shanghai and other places in the Far East. These arrangements have since been cancelled, apparently due to lack of support.

Delegates of the Council, bent on studying and solving problems of the world, which adults have proved incompetent to handle, were scheduled to arrive in Shanghai on July 21 and 22, 1935, where they would meet Chinese students and "Leaders Group Divisions."

According to the itinerary embodied in the attached pamphlets, the American contingent was due to leave San Francisco on June 14, 1935 aboard the "Hikawa Maru," en route to Canada, Japan and Korea. This contingent would link up with delegates from each country visited, and would proceed through Manchuria to Peiping, Nanking and Shanghai, finally departing for Manila via Hongkong, where a Pacific Area Students' Conference was scheduled to take place between July 30 and August 5, 1935. Delegates were to travel at their own expense.

As far as can be ascertained the said Council has no representative in Shanghai, although several communications on the subject have been addressed to Miss Stella Myers, c/o Shanghai Times, from Japanese sources.

Whether the "adults" who have proved incompetent to solve world problems may be taken to mean American and European nations is a matter of conjecture.

a Sansom.
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

Reg.
Usual authorities informed
Please file. MG 10 JULY 1935

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别课 登记... 6687 日期 1935年7月10日）

事由（全称）世界青年理事会太平洋区域理事会。

由 D.S. Sansom 撰写并呈送。

兹随函附上关于世界青年理事会太平洋区域理事会在访问上海及远东其他地区后，拟在马尼拉召开学生会议之若干安排的摘要报告。这些安排此后已被取消，显然是由于缺乏支持。

该理事会代表致力于研究和解决成年人被证明无力处理的世界性问题，原定于1935年7月21日和22日抵达上海，届时他们将与中国学生及“领袖小组分部”会面。

根据所附小册子中的行程计划，美国代表团应于1935年6月14日在旧金山登上“冰川丸”号（Hikawa Maru），途经加拿大、日本和朝鲜。该代表团将与沿途各国代表汇合，经满洲前往北平、南京和上海，最后经香港前往马尼拉，预定于1935年7月30日至8月5日期间在那里举行太平洋区域学生会议。代表们的旅费自理。

据查，该理事会在上海并无代表，尽管有几封来自日本方面的关于此事的信件寄给了转交《字林西报》（Shanghai Times）的 Stella Myers 小姐。

所谓“被证明无力解决世界问题”的“成年人”是否意指美国和欧洲国家，纯属猜测。

a Sansom.
D. S.

副总监（特别课）。

登记。
已通知常规主管机构
请归档。 MG 1935年7月10日

世界的问题并非由
成年人解决

因为明天当我们成为掌权的成年人时

REPORT
Date...... May 1, 1935.

Subject.................... World Council of Youth.

Made by...... D.S. Sansom. .................... Forwarded by... [签名]

With reference to the attached communication of April
29, 1935 from the North-China Daily News, enclosing a letter
from the World Council of Youth and requesting information
concerning this organization, I have to state that, according to
the local United States Consular Authorities, the movement is
of recent origin, having been founded in the United States by
a group of literary writers including Anne Mott-Smith. Little
notice has been taken of the group, whose activities are of an
idealistic character and considered to be harmless. There is
no evidence to indicate that the movement has taken root outside
of United States territory.

D. Sansom.
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

D. Sansom.

The World Council of Youth announces in 1966
for August, the first ever, a PACIFIC AND STUDENT
CONFERENCE to be held in Manila, the Philippine
Islands.

Delegates of all races, religions, national-
ities, creeds, or beliefs are invited from the
countries of the Pacific to confer on the problems
which face the world today.

You will agree that it is essential that we,
as young people, begin now to confer on problems
which we must face as responsible members of our
respective communities and nations.

This preliminary announcement will be follow-
ed at frequent intervals by more detailed informa-
tion.

Because the World Council of Youth is very in-
terested in these fields and in youth, we ask that
you have a part in these preparations.

Sincerely,

Anne Moss-Smith
Hawaii Secretary WCOY

尊敬的先生：

世界青年理事会宣布将于1966年8月在菲律宾群岛马尼拉举行首届太平洋学生会议。

邀请太平洋各国所有种族、宗教、国籍、信条或信仰的代表参加会议，共同商讨当今世界面临的问题。

您会同意，作为年轻人，我们现在开始商讨作为各自社区和国家负责任成员所必须面对的问题，是至关重要的。

在此初步公告之后，我们将频繁提供更详细的信息。

由于世界青年理事会对这些领域和青年非常感兴趣，我们请您参与这些准备工作。

此致

敬礼

Anne Moss-Smith
世界青年理事会夏威夷秘书
